// TSX edge cases: the two rules TSX prepends to :element_name -- a generic // type parameter list written `<T,>` (which TSX pops out of the element it had // started to open) and a `<` that opens a type argument list on a component. const identity = <T,>(value: T): T => value; export const Typed = () => <Box<string> prop="x" />; export const Both = () => ( <Wrapper<number, string> id={1}> <Inner<boolean> flag /> </Wrapper> );
